semantic_findings.finding: Child earned-income exemption tests only income_kind == earnings, while earned-income output also includes self_employment. A child self-employment payment can remain countable despite 13361 exempting earned income of household members under 18. Current diagnostic slice excludes self-employment.

Gift exemption requires both irregular and unpredictable. Source wording includes irregular, occasional or unpredictable gifts; those factual alternatives are not faithfully preserved. The partial $50 deduction above the threshold also needs an explicit source interpretation; do not assume source silence establishes that treatment.

income_kind is an unrestricted String. Unknown values can produce positive payment_countable_income but zero in both earned and unearned household sums. The reviewed binding uses only explicit earnings/unearned labels; production input admission should reject unrecognized kinds.

Self-employment averaging and strike treatment outside ordinary employment income are not established by this diagnostic slice. Several exemption facts named qualified/verified-exempt still collapse legal conditions into caller inputs. Full 13361 coverage is not independently established.

ci_assessment.conclusion: Rejection remains in force. The 77 diagnostics include 68 numeric-recall/occurrence messages, many apparently classifying references or narrative metadata as executable constants. That noise does not erase independently observed model defects and coverage gaps.
